title: Say which stories a release delivers or affects
statement: As a product manager, I can link a release to the stories it will deliver or affect, so anyone can see what the release means for users without reading its code.
overview: A story's URN survives moving between features and `feature deliver`, so these links survive a Roadmap feature being built.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each link says whether the release delivers the story or affects it, and the reader shows the two groups separately.
Linking a story that does not exist is refused.
A release's page lists its stories, and a story's page lists the releases that deliver or affect it, each linking to the other.
Removing a linked story leaves `status` and `check --covers health` reporting a dangling reference that names the release and the command that fixes it.
